idPolicy: Stable Eval IDs are EVAL-<DOMAIN>-<SLUG> and must not be filenames. Preserve or link existing Lab/business IDs (S10, I03, PT-25, S316A-RET-001) in `requirements` rather than competing with them.
maintenance: Update this Registry only when an important invariant/eval is introduced, materially changed, retired, found stale, or found missing because of a defect. Do not add an entry for every new unit test. Future manifests should reference Eval IDs where they materially prove a requirement.

evals.invariant: A completed current AI stage is presented as current, without a mapping-required contradiction, when the canonical projection says AI is complete.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Canonical projection reports AI complete/current; mapping is informational, not blocking.
evals.expectedUiResult: Materials, rail, and /sessions do not show mapping-required while AI is the completed current stage.

evals.invariant: One server-side post-processing projection supplies semantic stage state; clients do not independently reinterpret AUTO_SUGGESTED/CONFIRMED/readiness.
evals.expectedDomainResult: projectPostProcessingStages is the canonical semantic source.

evals.invariant: The same already-mounted materials UI converges from enhancement RUNNING to COMPLETED without reload or remount.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Successive materials/status payloads project RUNNING then COMPLETED.
evals.expectedUiResult: Rail and expanded transcript section on the same mounted tree both show COMPLETED.

evals.invariant: Historical AiAnalysis rows with inputFingerprint NULL remain readable using legacy transcriptId/retranscribeCount currentness.
evals.expectedDomainResult: NULL fingerprint rows evaluate as legacy_current when transcript identity matches.
evals.expectedUiResult: Historical materials/AI can open without treating NULL as missing/corrupt.

evals.invariant: First facilitator material mutation under new code binds a still-legacy-current NULL fingerprint to the pre-mutation envelope so the old AI becomes non-current.
evals.expectedDomainResult: EDIT binds NULL → pre-mutation hash; retranscribeCount unchanged; analysis no longer current.
evals.expectedUiResult: Facilitator workflow presents AI as needing rerun after that first edit, not as still-completed current output.

evals.invariant: Additive nullable AiAnalysis.inputFingerprint is deploy-ordered: new client must not read a database that lacks the column, and NEW CODE + OLD DB is fail-closed or prevented.
evals.expectedDomainResult: NEW CODE + NEW DB works. OLD CODE + NEW DB remains compatible because the column is nullable. NEW CODE + OLD DB is prevented by apply-schema-before-new-process or fails closed.
evals.expectedUiResult: Materials status must not 500 solely because the column is absent after a new client starts.

evals.invariant: Save transcript then Retranscribe uses the real confirmation interaction, not only a seeded final state.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Confirmed retranscription invalidates downstream once: new transcript generation, old AI non-current, active publication revoked in the claim transaction.
evals.expectedUiResult: The facilitator sees and acts on the real confirmation control before rewind proceeds.

evals.invariant: Lab I03 material-change confirmation uses the same application ConfirmDialog surface as production, not a native browser dialog.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Material save with active publication requires confirmation then revokes via Unshare.
evals.expectedUiResult: Site ConfirmDialog is the operator-visible control; native window.confirm is not the product path.

evals.invariant: Production-source window.alert, window.confirm, and window.prompt uses fail closed. Stage 3.19A requires zero production exceptions; any new native dialog must be allowlisted with a matching expectedCount.
evals.expectedDomainResult: The static guard passes with an empty production allowlist, fails for new non-allowlisted alert/confirm/prompt, fails when an allowlisted file/API occurrence count does not match expectedCount, and fails for stale allowlist entries.

evals.invariant: Standalone START_PREPARATION is allowed only when every assignable SessionRole slot is occupied and every negotiation PARTICIPANT has a valid assignable sessionRoleId; Event-created Sessions are not restricted by this guard.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Incomplete standalone start is rejected 409 STANDALONE_ROLES_NOT_READY; complete standalone start is allowed; Event-created start remains unrestricted by the standalone predicate.

evals.invariant: Standalone Start Preparation stays visible while role assignment is incomplete, is disabled with explanatory copy, and enables through the existing room sidebar poll once roles are ready.
evals.expectedDomainResult: The shared areStandalonePreparationRolesReady predicate drives the control; the server still rejects incomplete standalone start.
evals.expectedUiResult: start-preparation-button is visible and disabled with start-preparation-roles-hint until assignment is complete, then enables and START_PREPARATION succeeds.

evals.invariant: Transcript Insert after creates a synthetic empty manual turn after the chosen row, persist visual order via the existing orderIndex rewrite, and uses Insert after last as the append path after the global Add turn control was removed.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Inserted turns keep null timestamps; neighboring turn data is unchanged; submitted array order is the visual order the server rewrites as orderIndex 0..n-1.
evals.expectedUiResult: Each editable turn exposes Insert after; a saved insertion survives reload; there is no global Add turn control.

evals.invariant: An actual current-generation Vox conference disconnect sets joined=false and clears remoteParticipants so stale remotes cannot satisfy live tile eligibility.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Provider-state remotes are empty after current-generation disconnect; old endpoint objects cannot mutate a later generation.
evals.expectedUiResult: Disconnected current client does not present stale remote A/B tiles as live.

evals.invariant: Unexpected provider disconnect while the Session remains operable starts exactly one bounded access/join rejoin; Leave, unmount, stale lease, and non-operable Session never auto-rejoin; failed rejoin does not loop.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Client-only idle→recovering→recovered|failed; one attempt per mounted instance; remotes stay cleared on failure.
evals.expectedUiResult: Existing provider warning/error UI remains after failed recovery; manual page recovery still works.

evals.invariant: Late disconnect or endpoint callbacks from generation N cannot clear or mutate a recovered generation N+1.
evals.expectedDomainResult: shouldIgnoreProviderCallback drops stale-generation mutations; recovered remotes remain.

evals.invariant: Production-shaped ReInviteQueue IceRestartAction timeout is recoverable media/signalling degradation, not TERMINAL_PROVIDER_FAILURE/unclassified, and does not force full rejoin while the call remains connected.
evals.expectedDomainResult: actionName parses from JSON-in-message; class=RECOVERABLE_TRANSIENT reason=media_recovery_failed:IceRestartAction; connected call resyncs only.

evals.invariant: StreamManager NotReadableError Device in use is local-media non-terminal and must not clear remotes, mark the conference dead, or start provider rejoin.
evals.expectedDomainResult: class=RECOVERABLE_TRANSIENT reason=local_media_device_failure:NotReadableError; cameraUnavailable may be set; remotes unchanged.
evals.expectedUiResult: Existing camera unavailable / device-busy copy remains.

evals.invariant: A transient empty local SDK endpoint snapshot while the current conference is still connected does not wipe remotes; EndpointRemoved, actual disconnect, and a non-empty authoritative snapshot remain safe removal evidence.
evals.expectedDomainResult: reconcileRemoteParticipantsFromSnapshot keeps remotes on empty connected snapshot and prunes only with proven removal evidence.

evals.invariant: Optional transcript enhancement has race/correctness controls distinct from a bounded UX latency budget; late enhancement cannot overwrite later transcript/mapping/AI input.
evals.expectedDomainResult: No concurrent successful owners; timeout/failure leaves the current usable transcript terminal and non-authoritative for overwrite.
evals.expectedUiResult: Visible workflow is not blocked beyond the enhancement UX latency budget (default 7000ms).

evals.invariant: A facilitator-controlled material save against current published AI revokes the active publication as part of rewind.
evals.expectedDomainResult: 409 MATERIAL_CHANGE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED then revoke via existing Unshare; old row kept but not current.
evals.expectedUiResult: AI is presented as not current / needs rerun after confirmed rewind.

evals.invariant: Recipient access to a fingerprint-mismatched published analysis fails closed; grant existence is not enough.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Stale/current-fingerprint-mismatched publication is not readable by recipients.

evals.invariant: Structurally incomplete speaker mapping blocks AI start.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Canonical structural completeness is the blocker, not AUTO_SUGGESTED string alone.
evals.expectedUiResult: AI start is unavailable while mapping is incomplete / NEEDS_REVIEW / REQUIRED.

evals.invariant: PIPELINE_FIXTURE transcription runs the real auto-speaker-mapping path and can reach AUTO_SUGGESTED without the algorithm writing CONFIRMED.
evals.expectedDomainResult: autoTriggerSpeakerMappingAfterTranscription produces AUTO_SUGGESTED only; AM01 does not persist CONFIRMED.
evals.expectedUiResult: Complete AUTO_SUGGESTED is informational, not an unresolved blocker.

evals.invariant: Canonical session finish/close follows the server lifecycle contract rather than a client-only terminal label.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Finish lands on the canonical terminal session state owned by session-event flow.
evals.expectedUiResult: Room/session surfaces stop presenting an open room after canonical close.

evals.invariant: Default smoke suites prove critical journeys against mock providers without live Voximplant/Yandex side effects.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Mock-mode smoke covers curated @smoke journeys without real provider calls.

evals.invariant: Live-provider tests are explicit, opt-in, cost-bearing, and never part of default L4 gates.
evals.expectedDomainResult: @live-provider suites exist and are excluded from default smoke/L4.

evals.invariant: High-risk product stages, where practical, accept 1 realistic historical session and 1 new happy-flow session before deploy.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Historical cohort remains operable under new code; new session completes the happy path.
evals.expectedUiResult: Operator can complete the real local/production-like surfaces without Lab-only fixtures.

evals.invariant: A synthetic historical post-processing shape opens and projects readable materials/AI without requiring a production data copy.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Historical mapped/confirmed shapes remain readable and project coherent stages.

evals.invariant: Curated smoke covers public/private authorization and invite/ownership integrity without live providers.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Private resources stay authorization-gated; invite/ownership integrity holds in mock mode.

evals.invariant: Transcript/material edit that can conflict with enhancement is blocked while enhancement is RUNNING, on both client and server.
evals.expectedDomainResult: View remains allowed; transcript/mapping/manual-attribution writes return 409 while enhancement is RUNNING.
evals.expectedUiResult: Edit/save controls are blocked or explain the in-progress enhancement.

evals.invariant: The canonical write schema accepts a structurally complete report including empty arrays and strips extra keys, and rejects wrong element types and missing required fields. The incident path listeningAndReframing.missedOpportunities.0 is one demonstrated case of a wrong-element-type rejection, not a separate registry item.
evals.expectedDomainResult: NegotiationAnalysisOutputSchema.safeParse accepts canonical and sparse-empty-array output and fails object/null/number missedOpportunities[0] at listeningAndReframing.missedOpportunities.0.

evals.invariant: Recoverable wrapper noise (markdown JSON fence, surrounding prose that contains a balanced JSON object, trailing commas) is normalized by the existing bounded helpers and then schema-validated; it is not MODEL_INVALID_OUTPUT solely because of that wrapper noise. Irrecoverable malformed JSON (truncated, no parseable balanced object, or otherwise unparseable after those helpers) classifies as MODEL_INVALID_OUTPUT and is never persisted as valid analysis. Recovery stays inside the existing fence-strip, first-balanced-object, and trailing-comma helpers; no additional repair is authorized.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Fenced, surrounding-prose, and trailing-comma valid JSON parse and proceed to schema validation. Truncated or otherwise unparseable JSON after current bounded helpers is MODEL_INVALID_OUTPUT, not MODEL_SCHEMA_VALIDATION_ERROR, and is not persisted.

evals.invariant: Same owned analysis operation and same already-built prompt: Yandex generation 1 is schema-invalid at a structural boundary; generation 2 is valid; only generation 2 becomes COMPLETED/current. AiAnalysis stays ANALYZING between attempts.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Exactly two Yandex generation POSTs, one complete, zero fail, one analysisVersion, only the valid second output persisted.

evals.invariant: Same owned analysis operation and same already-built prompt: Yandex generation 1 schema-invalid, generation 2 schema-invalid, terminal FAILED, no third generation.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Exactly two generation POSTs, fail exactly once, durable FAILED, no current analysisJson.

evals.invariant: After generation 1 schema-invalid, a newer owner/current analysis cannot be completed, failed, or given a provider response id by the stale owned operation, and the stale operation must not start generation 2.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Lost-ownership precheck yields zero second-generation POSTs; stale complete/fail/persist are rejected; newer token remains authoritative.

evals.invariant: Schema failures journal bounded diagnostics (error class, issue count, issue paths, issue codes, expected/received kinds, lengths, lifecycle fields) on ExternalServiceEvent through a fail-closed positive allowlist. Unknown keys, free-form issues/prose, candidate, responseBody, transcript, notes, hiddenInfo, and raw model text are dropped.
evals.expectedDomainResult: buildBoundedAiAnalysisLogPayload and schema-issue helpers persist only positively allowlisted structured fields; unknown or prose-bearing keys do not persist.

evals.invariant: A DEBRIEF_OPEN Session empty of current-generation room occupancy remains open at 59s and closes at/after 60s through finalizeSessionCanonicalClose with DEBRIEF_EMPTY_TIMEOUT.
evals.expectedDomainResult: evaluateSessionLifecyclePolicy reports not_due at 59s and due/DEBRIEF_EMPTY_TIMEOUT at 60s; the same policy is consumed by leave, poll, Event-state, and the 15s sweeper. The fenced finalizer writes DEBRIEF_EMPTY_TIMEOUT.

evals.invariant: The Stage 3.10 maintenance CLI is a raw tsx/Node operational runtime: env bootstrap happens before Prisma/config that require DATABASE_URL, and --task all does not import Next-only server-only modules.
evals.expectedDomainResult: npm run maintenance:stage310 -- --task all loads under raw tsx. Local/non-production loads project .env* from cwd first. Production uses systemd EnvironmentFile and does not load local Next env. --task all --dry-run executes every current task with zero writes.

evals.invariant: Occupied Debrief survives the empty grace but closes at/after SESSION_DEBRIEF_MAX_DURATION_MS from negotiationEndedAt. Earliest eligible reason wins; tied dueAts prefer DEBRIEF_EMPTY_TIMEOUT.
evals.expectedDomainResult: S06 remains open; S06b due/DEBRIEF_MAX_DURATION; S07 earliest reason wins.
evals.expectedUiResult: Occupied hard-close uses the existing CLOSED / ROOM_CLOSED control-state redirect, same as manual complete.

evals.invariant: Non-Debrief empty Sessions close after SESSION_ABANDONED_CLOSE_MS. Event-created reference is max(rawReferenceAt, Event.scheduledAt) for both never-entered and early-occupied children. Pre-finish abandoned Sessions reuse completeSessionCanonical so negotiation FINISHED, negotiationEndedAt, room CLOSED, and the first recording-stop intent are coherent; Debrief automatic close still does not start a second stop.
evals.expectedDomainResult: S08 not closed at 60s; S09/S10 due at 3h; S11/S11b wait for scheduledAt+3h; S12/S12b use the approved floor. PREPARATION/READY_TO_START abandon without an unnecessary stop; RUNNING/PAUSED abandon finishes once and claims at most one stop.

evals.invariant: Current-generation occupancy and departure timestamps invalidate an obsolete empty deadline. A later leave starts a new dueAt. Live expiresAt is not empty-since.
evals.expectedDomainResult: S03/S05 occupied wins; S04 new 60s deadline; superseded generations and live expiresAt are ignored. A stale due evaluation cannot close after an authoritative rejoin commits.

evals.invariant: Claim/rejoin and canonical Session close serialize on the Session row. First fenced UPDATE wins; a newly admitted user is never left inside a CLOSED Session. The shared atomic finalizer race is not by itself the full manual-orchestration race.
evals.expectedDomainResult: R1/R2 claim vs finalize remain linearized. Abandoned close uses the same lock: claim-first leaves RUNNING/OPEN with no stop; close-first is CLOSED and refuses the later claim. Real manual completeSessionCanonical vs abandoned yields one terminal lifecycle and at most one stop.

evals.invariant: The first new-code evaluation of CLOSED, deleted, FINISHED+NULL, Event-closed, or DEBRIEF_OPEN-under-terminal-parent Sessions is an automatic no-op.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Policy decision already_terminal or ineligible; no automatic reason is emitted. A stale due evaluation cannot close after the parent Event becomes COMPLETED/CANCELLED/deleted.

evals.invariant: Dashboard Event Active/Archive is a derived presentation lane: explicit COMPLETED/CANCELLED win; otherwise current lobby presence or an operable child Session wins over scheduledAt; otherwise scheduledAt >= now or unscheduled is ACTIVE and past idle is ARCHIVE. Exactly one lane. Historical terminal children do not make an Event ACTIVE.
evals.expectedDomainResult: classifyEventDashboardLane and partitionDashboardEventsByLane implement E01-E04, E08, E11-E15 with injected now. No Event row is mutated.
evals.expectedUiResult: An Event card appears in Active or Archive, never both.

evals.invariant: For a non-terminal Event only, Archive↔Active lane changes follow current lobby occupancy or operable child Session without a persisted Event status transition.
evals.expectedDomainResult: E05/E07: past idle ARCHIVE → lobby occupancy or a later host-created operable child Session → ACTIVE → activity disappears and scheduledAt still past → ARCHIVE. Event.status is not completed/cancelled merely because the Event is historical.
evals.expectedUiResult: Reload of Dashboard shows the Event in exactly one updated lane.

evals.invariant: Archive listing does not deny Lobby entry or reuse of a past idle non-terminal Event. Join and later Session create/start stay on existing Event lifecycle/authorization rules. scheduledAt < now and dashboardLane ARCHIVE are not access predicates.
evals.expectedDomainResult: canAccessEvent, isEventOpenAndJoinable, Event host POST, and createSessionFromEvent ignore scheduledAt and dashboard lane. joinTrainingEvent still only rejects deleted/COMPLETED/CANCELLED. An authorized host can create the next Session for a past ARCHIVE Event.
evals.expectedUiResult: A derived-past Archive Event card still exposes Open lobby; the authorized Lobby page loads; host POST creates a real child Session.

evals.invariant: Session user-facing Online is unique current SessionRoomConnection occupancy on an operable Session. SessionParticipant.lastSeenAt alone never implies Online. Explicit Leave makes the next read Offline immediately.
evals.expectedDomainResult: P01-P10: live lease → Online; explicit leave / stale lastSeenAt / superseded / revoked / expired / terminal Session → Offline; duplicate tabs count as 1; all room roles count equally.
evals.expectedUiResult: Sessions list Online N and Session detail Online now drop the leaver on the next ordinary poll/stream without waiting 30s.

evals.invariant: Event who-is-where uses Room > Lobby > Offline. Event Online is the unique union of current Lobby users and current operable child-room users. lastSeenAt-only Session heartbeat does not create Event Online.
evals.expectedDomainResult: E-P01-E-P12: Lobby only / Session only / overlap / neither / stale Lobby / closed child / leave / leave-then-lobby / distributed people / observer.
evals.expectedUiResult: Event lobby presence indicator moves Lobby → Session → Offline on ordinary state poll and never double-counts the same person.

evals.invariant: GET /api/sessions/{sessionId}/presence/stream is account-authenticated and gated by canManageSession. It is not demo@example.com scoped and does not admit unrelated authenticated users. Authorized managers receive 200 text/event-stream with a current lease-derived snapshot; unauthenticated callers receive 401; unrelated callers receive 404.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Authorized manager/Event host/admin/facilitator: 200 SSE first snapshot. Unauthenticated: 401. Unrelated or non-manager participant: 404. Fresh Standalone with no SessionRoomConnection: 200 Offline.
evals.expectedUiResult: The management participants table EventSource stays open for a real logged-in manager and does not 404 on a non-demo Session.

evals.invariant: An already-mounted Dashboard converges to newly created Sessions and Events from the canonical /api/sessions/list and /api/events/list poll without remount or manual refresh, using the same 2000 ms visible-list cadence as /sessions and /events. Session and Event last-good snapshots update independently.
evals.expectedDomainResult: applyDashboardListPoll updates only the successful list side, rebuilds from latest-good Sessions plus latest-good Events, and keeps the previous state when both sides fail.
evals.expectedUiResult: A mounted /dashboard shows the new Session or Event after one 2-second visible-list poll cycle (or immediately on focus/visible) without duplicates or a cleared list, even if the other list request fails.

evals.invariant: A second validation run in the same worktree fails fast with VALIDATION_ALREADY_RUNNING when the lock owner PID is alive and command/worktree match.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Exactly one atomic worktree validation.lock owner; the second run prints existing owner information and does not start steps.

evals.invariant: Sibling git worktrees use distinct <worktree>/.agent/validation.lock paths and remain independently validatable.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Lock paths are worktree-scoped. No machine-global, Git common-directory, or main-worktree lock is used.

evals.invariant: validate:deploy acquires the validation lock once and runs internal FAST then BUILD without shelling out to the independently locking public validate:fast command.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Inner FAST/BUILD steps see VALIDATION_ALREADY_RUNNING if they try to reacquire; deploy completes without deadlock.

evals.invariant: Canonical prisma:generate and validation generate share a worktree prisma-generate.lock and generated-client integrity check using the installed Prisma CLI.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Concurrent same-worktree generate fails fast. Missing client.ts or a non-callable Prisma.sql/join returns PRISMA_CLIENT_INTEGRITY_FAILED.

evals.invariant: A hung validation-owned child is terminated by the step/run watchdog. Cleanup operates only on the owned root PID/tree and never kills by image name.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Timeout returns VALIDATION_TIMEOUT, dumps owned process info, removes the owned tree, and leaves an unrelated synthetic process alive.

evals.invariant: Force cleanup of a previously snapshotted PID whose parent/root relationship is gone must rematch process identity (PID + start time, plus name/command line when present) and must not kill a reused PID.
evals.expectedDomainResult: An injected inspector that reports the same PID with a different start time records PID_REUSED_OR_IDENTITY_CHANGED, does not invoke force kill, and returns CHILD_CLEANUP_FAILED. Unrelated processes remain untouched.

evals.invariant: Windows owned-tree cleanup must not classify an incomplete or timed-out process inspection as PID reuse. A PID that exits during inspect is GONE. An incomplete snapshot of the still-alive owned root may be force-killed. Proven start-time reuse still refuses kill.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Presence is GONE, ALIVE_SAME_IDENTITY, PID_REUSED, or INSPECTION_UNCERTAIN. T07 still returns VALIDATION_TIMEOUT. Incomplete owned-root snapshot and inspectFailed-then-gone do not return a false CHILD_CLEANUP_FAILED. T21 still refuses a reused PID.

evals.invariant: Operator SIGINT/SIGTERM cancels a public validation run once, cleans only the owned child tree, and releases worktree locks only when the lock payload still belongs to this runId.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Cancellation exits VALIDATION_CANCELLED, the owned child is gone, validation.lock is removed, an unrelated synthetic child survives, and a changed lock runId is not deleted.

evals.invariant: PG coordination tests cannot wait forever for a lock/barrier signal that can no longer occur. A mutation or finalization rejection, or a bounded barrier timeout, must unblock the waiter; opened pg clients must still receive a cleanup attempt.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Waiter rejects with the original upstream error or a deterministic timeout. Intended FOR UPDATE serialization remains asserted on the healthy path. Clients are ended with allSettled semantics.

evals.invariant: Four managed Vox E2E slots use fixed User.id values that survive recreation and ordinary cleanup, derive stable distinct ng_u_* usernames only from production buildVoximplantUsernameForUser, and ordinary managed Playwright validation cannot inherit VIDEO_PROVIDER=voximplant. Production identity and Management API source stay unchanged. Historical remote Vox users are not cleaned automatically; operator-gated dry-run inventory is a separate eval.
evals.expectedDomainResult: Same slot → same User.id → same ng_u_*. Cleanup preserves managed User and VideoProviderIdentity while deleting ephemeral users and managed users' per-test Session/Event memberships. Real-Vox access tests isolate managed membership from shared serial fixtures. DB fixtures do not plant ACTIVE ng_u_fixture_* identities on canonical slots. resolveManagedPlaywrightVideoProvider defaults to livekit unless PLAYWRIGHT_VIDEO_PROVIDER=voximplant.

evals.invariant: Historical Vox ng_u_* orphan classification is dry-run by default, fail-closed if production or local-manual keep-lists cannot load, keeps production/local-manual/managed-E2E/explicit POC identities, treats hash collisions as AMBIGUOUS_BLOCKED, and never exposes user_id=all or wildcard deletion. Apply requires explicit --apply plus --expected-count and refuses candidate-set drift; batch DelUser stops after the first failure. Live dry-run uses GetUsers only.
evals.expectedDomainResult: VC-01..VC-16: keep/delete/ambiguous/fail-closed/dry-run-zero-DelUser/apply-fence/wildcard-absent/batch-stop. Username derivation remains production buildVoximplantUsernameForUser.

evals.invariant: Retranscription downloads source bytes before admitTranscriptionRun. A missing retained object returns SOURCE_RECORDING_NOT_AVAILABLE with zero material mutations. Recording COMPLETED remains historical truth. Successful retranscription still invalidates downstream AI/publication once.
evals.expectedDomainResult: GET NotFound before admission: 409 SOURCE_RECORDING_NOT_AVAILABLE; retranscribeCount, history, transcript, AI currentness, publication, and grants unchanged. Timeout is not classified as source absence. Successful preload admits once and reuses the buffer.
evals.expectedUiResult: Both retranscription surfaces show that the original recording file is unavailable so retranscription cannot start, and that the saved transcript and AI analysis remain available. Copy is neutral and does not claim retention expiration as the cause. Client does not clear historical results.
